title: Harmonize microcopy and state transitions for dense text fields and selects
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce visual ambiguity and inconsistent microcopy across dense (tight spacing) text inputs, selects, and toggle-style inputs; unify validation layering and the timing of assistive message changes. Motivation: multiple product teams report confusing inline messages and flickering state changes in high-density tables and compact forms, increasing support tickets and regression risk during runtime-optimized deployments. This ticket scopes design updates, token guidance, and handoff artifacts for an engineering implementation that preserves backward compatibility where practicable.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Single source guidance for microcopy across placeholder, helper text, and error text for 'dense' and 'default' density modes (content examples included). 2) Motion and opacity specs for state transitions (focus, error, success) that avoid layout shift in compact containers. 3) Token changes documented: spacing adjustments, z-index for popovers, contrast ratios for error/disabled/placeholder using existing color tokens. 4) Figma component variants updated and linked; dev-ready token diff and migration notes published in Confluence. 5) Accessibility review sign-off (contrast & screen-reader order) and a regression test checklist added to QA drive. 6) Implementation plan with minimal breaking changes and a fallback strategy for legacy consumers.

design_decisions: Prefer persistent helper text for dense rows if it provides task-critical guidance; otherwise use a collapsed, hover-reveal helper for non-essential hints.
Use a single 'validation-layer' z-index token to ensure error overlays and tooltips appear consistently above autofill and browser-native UI.
Transitions: 100ms fade for color/opacity changes, 0ms layout changes to avoid reflow; avoid motion that changes element size in dense contexts.
Microcopy: standardize on sentence case for errors and helper text; include a suggested 3-word max summary for helper labels in dense mode to prevent wrapping.
Tokens: introduce spacing.token.dense.input-vertical = 6px and spacing.token.dense.input-horizontal = 8px; create color.token.text.placeholder.dense with improved contrast against dark surfaces.
attachments: QA checklist (regression tests & screen-reader steps): https://drive.google.com/file/d/ExampleQA
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Token changes could break teams that override tokens directly. Mitigation: keep new tokens additive and provide a migration guide with examples.
Risk: Dense mode helper text persistence could increase visual noise. Mitigation: provide clear criteria for when helper text must persist (task-critical vs optional).
Risk: Live validation under high throughput causes latency spikes. Mitigation: align with ENG-44211 debounce policy and provide API flags to opt-out of live validation per route.
